periods.label: 隐藏观战的色彩魔法使

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: observes the final hidden by Color Magic

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent and model of interest; she congratulates him after the final.
relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Companion she helps conceal near the venue.
relationships.edelweiss: Acquaintance who arrives to watch the final.

periods.summary: Sara uses Color Magic to hide herself, Rinna, Charlotte and Tsukikage at a cafe near the venue. She notices Edelweiss approaching and later watches the final, sketching the duel until she asks Edelweiss about the meaning of Ikki and Stella no longer matching. After Ikki wins, she quietly congratulates him.

key_events.summary: Conceals the group and identifies Edelweiss's arrival.
Reacts from the Akatsuki side after Ikki's victory.

periods.label: 被雾子缠上的染血达文西

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: attends Ikki's victory party and is trapped by drunken Kiriko
status.condition: physically weak and uncomfortable under Kiriko's examination

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former opponent/model whose victory party she attends.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Drunken doctor who clings to her and proposes muscle/fat experiments.

periods.summary: Sara attends Ikki's post-tournament celebration despite being an Akatsuki-associated former opponent. During the party, Kiriko gets drunk and clings to Sara, commenting on her weak muscles and proposing experimental research to convert fat into muscle, leaving Sara helplessly asking for rescue. Sara's presence also prompts jokes about drawing a missing bathhouse Mount Fuji mural later in the chapter.

key_events.summary: Appears at the party and becomes Kiriko's unwilling target.

periods.label: 试图警告一辉的莎拉

name.jp: サラ・ブラッドリリー

status.current: at ruined Rebellion headquarters when communications fail

relationships.rinna-kazamatsuri: Adoptive younger sister figure accompanying her.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Has his phone number and tries to warn him when she realizes he may be in Vermillion.

periods.summary: Sara accompanies Rinna and Charlotte to the devastated Rebellion headquarters. The massacre's resemblance to a conflict zone darkens her mood. After Tsukikage reveals Or-Gaule's plan to destroy Vermillion and Quedland, Rinna remembers that Ikki and Stella planned to visit Vermillion, and Sara immediately tries to call Ikki because she has his number. The call cannot connect, emphasizing that communications have already been disrupted before SCION arrives.

key_events.summary: Attempts to call Ikki after learning Or-Gaule is targeting Vermillion and Quedland.

abilities: knight ability not foregrounded in this volume segment
